# Vasudev Chemo Pharma

> ISO 9001:2015 certified direct manufacturer and exporter of industrial, specialty, and surfactant chemicals.
> Headquartered at GIDC Ankleshwar, Gujarat, India. Founded 2020.
> Exports to 14+ countries across the Middle East, Americas, Southeast Asia, and Africa.
> Flagship product: MEA Triazine 78% H2S Scavenger (CAS 4719-04-4) — one of the highest active-content triazine scavengers available globally.

## Product Catalog (13 products)

Vasudev Chemo Pharma manufactures three product categories. All products ship in 210L HDPE drums, 1000L IBC tanks, or bulk tanker. MOQ typically 1 MT.

ADBAC cationic surfactant / quaternary ammonium biocide. 50% aqueous solution. Hospital surface disinfectant active, food-contact sanitiser (FDA 21 CFR 178.1010), pool algicide, cosmetic preservative (INCI: Benzalkonium Chloride). Functionally equivalent to Lonza Bardac® 22 / Stepan BTC® 824 / Nouryon Maquat® MC 1412.

ADBAC concentrate. 80% aqueous solution — export-economical grade for global disinfectant brands and sanitiser blenders. Functionally equivalent to Lonza Bardac® 2280 / Stepan BTC® 8358 / Nouryon Maquat® 4480-E / Pilot Lonzabac® 80%. Available in Industrial / Technical, Cosmetic Grade (CTFA), and Disinfectant Grade (EPA-registered formulators). ISO 9001:2015 + GMP + Halal certified.

## MEA Triazine 78% — Quick Facts

MEA Triazine (1,3,5-Tris(2-hydroxyethyl)hexahydro-s-triazine) is the most widely used liquid H2S scavenger in oil & gas. It reacts irreversibly with H2S to form dithiazine — a water-soluble, non-hazardous by-product. One mole of triazine can scavenge up to three moles of H2S.

- **CAS Number:** 4719-04-4
- **Molecular formula:** C₆H₁₅N₃O₃ · Molecular weight: 177.20 g/mol
- **Active content:** ≥ 78%
- **pH (1% solution):** 10.0 – 12.0
- **Specific gravity (25°C):** 1.10 – 1.15
- **Flash point:** > 93°C
- **Freezing point:** < −5°C
- **Typical dosing:** 3–6 gallons per pound of H2S removed
- **Packaging:** 210L HDPE drums · 1000L IBC · bulk tanker
- **HS Code:** 29336990
- **GHS classification:** H315 / H319 / H335 (Warning, Irritant)

## MEA Triazine vs MMA Triazine

| Property | MEA Triazine 78% | MMA Triazine 40% |
|----------|------------------|------------------|
| Active content | 78% | 40% |
| Base amine | Monoethanolamine | Monomethylamine |
| CAS Number | 4719-04-4 | 108-74-7 |
| H2S capacity per unit volume | Higher | Lower |
| BTEX emissions | Possible (gas-phase) | BTEX-free |
| Primary use | Oil & gas H2S scavenging | Water treatment, biocide |
| Freezing point | < −5°C | < −15°C |

Detailed comparison: [MEA Triazine vs MMA Triazine](https://www.vasudevchemopharma.com/mea-triazine-vs-mma-triazine)

## Hydrotropes — Quick Facts

Hydrotropes are short-chain aromatic sulfonate salts that increase the solubility of hydrophobic surfactants and organic compounds in water. Vasudev Chemo Pharma manufactures two hydrotrope families — Sodium Cumene Sulfonate (SCS) and Sodium Xylene Sulfonate (SXS) — each in a 40% aqueous liquid and a 90% free-flowing powder grade.

### Sodium Cumene Sulfonate (SCS) — CAS 28348-53-0

- **Chemistry:** Sodium salt of cumenesulfonic acid (isopropylbenzenesulfonic acid sodium salt). Molecular formula C9H11NaO3S, MW 222.24 g/mol.
- **SCS-40 (liquid):** 40 ± 1% active matter · pH 7–9 · clear to pale-yellow liquid · ships in 250 kg HDPE drums / 1000 L IBC / 22 MT ISO tank · 24-month shelf life · preferred for cold-blend processes and regional supply.
- **SCS-90 (powder):** 90 ± 1% active matter · free-flowing powder · ships in 25 kg bags / 500 kg or 1000 kg jumbo bags · ~60% lower freight cost per kg active than the 40% liquid · preferred for long-haul export and spray-dried / dry-blended formulations.
- **Primary applications:** clear liquid detergents, hand dish wash concentrates, HI&I hard-surface cleaners, agrochemical EC/SL concentrates, oilfield acid-coupling additives, textile wetting auxiliaries.
- **Typical dosage:** 1–8% on finished product weight depending on surfactant loading and target cloud point.
- **Safety:** GHS Category 2A eye irritant only · readily biodegradable · REACH pre-registered · non-hazardous for transport under IMDG/ADR.

### Sodium Xylene Sulfonate (SXS) — CAS 1300-72-7

- **Chemistry:** Sodium salt of dimethylbenzenesulfonic acid (mixed xylene isomers). Molecular formula C8H9NaO3S, MW 208.21 g/mol.
- **SXS-40 (liquid):** 40 ± 1% active matter · pH 7–9 · pale-yellow liquid · ships in 250 kg HDPE drums / 1000 L IBC / 22 MT ISO tank · preferred for high-electrolyte alkaline cleaners and laundry liquids.
- **SXS-90 (powder):** 90 ± 1% active matter · free-flowing powder · preferred for spray-dried laundry powders, built alkaline concentrates, industrial degreasers, dry blends, and agrochemical water-dispersible granules.
- **Primary applications:** household and HI&I alkaline cleaners, laundry liquids and powders, hand dish wash, vehicle wash concentrates, industrial degreasers, agrochemical WDG/SL systems, textile auxiliaries, paper-processing aids, leather glue/additives, and personal-care surfactant bases.
- **SXS-90 buyer checklist:** Confirm COA, SDS, TDS, active matter, pH, moisture, sulfate content, bag size, shelf life, sample terms, MOQ, and Incoterms before approving a bulk order.
- **SCS vs SXS guidance:** SCS out-performs SXS per gram of active in nonionic-dominated systems. SXS delivers stronger electrolyte tolerance in alkaline or salt-rich cleaners. For most mainstream household dish wash and laundry concentrates, SXS-40 is the default; switch to SCS-40 when nonionic loading or cold-storage clarity is the binding constraint.
- **40% vs 90% decision:** Choose 40% liquid when regional freight distance is short (<2500 km) or cold-blend processing is preferred. Choose 90% powder for long-haul CIF export and spray-dried / dry-blend formulations.

## Benzalkonium Chloride (BKC / ADBAC) — Quick Facts

Benzalkonium Chloride (BKC, ADBAC, CAS 8001-54-5) is a broad-spectrum cationic surfactant and quaternary ammonium biocide — the global standard active substance in hospital surface disinfectants, food-contact sanitisers, swimming pool algicides, cosmetic preservatives, and pharmaceutical preservation. Vasudev Chemo Pharma manufactures BKC 50% (liquid, ready-to-formulate) and BKC 80% (concentrate, export-economical) at our ISO 9001:2015, GMP, and Halal certified facility in Gujarat, India.

- **CAS Number (mixture):** 8001-54-5 · Alternate (chain-specific): 63449-41-2, 68391-01-5, 68424-85-1
- **EC / EINECS Number:** 264-151-6 (also 269-919-4) · **HS Code:** 29239000 · **EPA PC Code:** 069105
- **INCI Name (cosmetics):** Benzalkonium Chloride · **UNII:** F5UM2KM3W7
- **Chemical class:** Alkyl Dimethyl Benzyl Ammonium Chloride (ADBAC) — cationic surfactant + quaternary ammonium biocide
- **Active matter:** BKC 50% = 50.0 ± 1.0% · BKC 80% = 80.0 ± 1.0%
- **Alkyl distribution:** C₁₂ 40-50% / C₁₄ 30-40% / C₁₆ 10-20% (typical, matches global formulation reference)
- **Molecular weight (avg, C₁₂–C₁₆):** 354.0 g/mol
- **Form (50%):** Clear pale yellow liquid · **Form (80%):** Pale yellow viscous liquid (gel below 15°C — store ≥ 15°C)
- **pH (10% solution, 25°C):** 6.0 – 8.0 · **Specific gravity (50%):** 0.96–1.00 · **(80%):** 1.00–1.04
- **GHS classification:** GHS05 / GHS07 / GHS09 (Danger). H302, H314, H318, H400, H410.
- **Shelf life:** 24 months in sealed HDPE drums
- **Packaging:** 50 kg / 200 kg HDPE drums · 1000 kg IBC · ISO tank · MOQ 1 MT
- **Vasudev SKUs:** BKC 50% = VCP-SFC-0005 · BKC 80% = VCP-SFC-0006
- **Certifications:** ISO 9001:2015 + GMP + Halal (Kosher available on request)
- **Grades:** Industrial / Technical · Cosmetic Grade (CTFA-compliant) · Disinfectant Grade (suitable for EPA-registered formulators)

### BKC — How it works as a disinfectant

BKC is a cationic surfactant — its positively charged quaternary ammonium head binds to the negatively charged outer membrane of bacteria, fungi, and enveloped viruses, disrupts the lipid bilayer, leaks intracellular contents, and inactivates the cell. Effective against gram-positive and gram-negative bacteria, fungi, yeasts, algae, and enveloped viruses (coronaviruses, influenza, herpes, HIV). Listed in US EPA List N for SARS-CoV-2.

### BKC — Use concentrations

| Application | Active concentration | Notes |
|----|----|----|
| Hospital surface disinfection | 0.1% – 0.4% active quat | EN 1276 / EN 14476 validated |
| Food-contact no-rinse sanitiser | Max 200 ppm active | FDA 21 CFR 178.1010 |
| Swimming pool algicide (preventive) | 5 – 15 ppm active | Synergistic with chlorine |
| Cooling tower / HVAC biocide | 50 – 200 ppm active | Legionella control |
| Cosmetic preservation (rinse-off) | Max 0.1% active | Cosmetics Europe Annex V |
| Cosmetic preservation (leave-on) | Max 0.05% active | Cosmetics Europe Annex V |
| Pharmaceutical preservation | 0.001% – 0.01% active | USP <51>, BP, EP, IP, JP |
| Veterinary / agricultural disinfection | 0.2% – 1.0% active | Poultry, dairy, hatcheries |
| Wood preservation | 0.5% – 2.0% active | Surface-spray or pressure treatment |
| Oilfield biocide (produced water) | 50 – 200 ppm active | SRB / biofilm control |

### BKC 50% vs BKC 80% — Decision guide

| Factor | BKC 50% | BKC 80% |
|----|----|----|
| Active matter | 50% | 80% |
| Form | Free-flowing liquid | Viscous (gel below 15°C) |
| Storage | 5 – 40°C | 15 – 40°C (heated in cold climates) |
| Best for | Direct formulation, regional supply | Bulk export, on-site dilution |
| Freight cost per kg active | Baseline | ~37% lower than BKC 50% |
| Lonza brand equivalent | Bardac® 22, Hyamine® 3500 | Bardac® 2280 |
| Stepan brand equivalent | BTC® 824, BTC® 50NF | BTC® 8358 |
| Nouryon brand equivalent | Maquat® MC 1412 | Maquat® 4480-E |
| Pilot brand equivalent | Lonzabac® 50 | Lonzabac® 80 |

To make BKC 50% from BKC 80%: blend 62.5 kg BKC 80% + 37.5 kg demineralised water → 100 kg BKC 50%.

### BKC — Compatibility (CRITICAL)

BKC is INCOMPATIBLE with anionic surfactants (LABSA, SLES, SLS, soaps, anionic hydrotropes such as SCS / SXS). Mixing forms an insoluble ion-pair complex that destroys biocidal activity. BKC IS compatible with nonionic surfactants (alcohol ethoxylates, APGs, Tween series), amphoteric surfactants (cocamidopropyl betaine), and other cationic systems.

### BKC — Regulatory references

- **US EPA:** Registered active substance, PC Code 069105. Listed in EPA List N for SARS-CoV-2.
- **US FDA:** Approved no-rinse food-contact sanitiser under 21 CFR 178.1010 (max 200 ppm). Listed in OTC monograph for healthcare antiseptic active.
- **EU BPR:** Approved active substance under product types 1 (human hygiene), 2 (non-food disinfectant), 3 (veterinary hygiene), 4 (food and feed area).
- **REACH (EU):** Pre-registered. Full registration available through EU representatives.
- **Pharmacopoeia:** Compendial monographs in USP, NF, BP, EP (Ph. Eur.), IP (Indian Pharmacopoeia), JP (Japanese Pharmacopoeia).
- **Cosmetics:** INCI 'Benzalkonium Chloride' (Cosmetics Europe Annex V).
